# XLSX reader and writer

- Library: SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3
- Local browser file: `xlsx.full.min.js`
- Download source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
- Project and documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/
- License: Apache License 2.0; see `LICENSE` and the library file's license banner.
- Purpose: read source workbooks and create new report workbooks in the browser without a runtime CDN request.

Downloaded on 2026-10-20. Source workbooks are never written by the library integration.
